scope.agentic_execution: Agent interviews and interprets owner records
scope.guided_transformation: Owner evidence becomes a saved audit and continuing plan

stages.name: interview-and-ratify
stages.activity: ONBOARDING.md captures answers; owner ratifies SCALE-BRIEF.md

stages.name: audit-sweep-and-choose
stages.input: Owner-declared roots and classes from Q4
stages.activity: WIZARD.md inventories sources and records each owner disposition in ASSETS.md

stages.name: assess-needed-versus-park
stages.activity: Classify every proposed capability in SCOPE.md with owner and wake condition

stages.name: recommend-research
stages.activity: RESEARCH.md records question, source, recency, use, limits, and owner disposition for each relevant class

stages.name: guide-and-callable-manual
stages.activity: Use both guides; test supported and unsupported help; owner adopts the exact plan

operator_gates.subject: SCALE-BRIEF.md exact saved version or digest
ASSETS.md exact inventory version or digest
